name: EM FX Performance Across Fed Hiking & Cutting Cycles
description: Analyzes BRL, MXN, and ZAR performance during each Fed hiking and cutting cycle since 2000 using hardcoded FOMC cycle date boundaries. FX pairs (USD/BRL, USD/MXN, USD/ZAR) are inverted so positive returns = local currency appreciation. Seven cycles: Cut 1 (01-03), Hike 1 (04-06), Cut 2 (07-08), Hike 2 (15-18), Cut 3 (19-20), Hike 3 (22-23), Cut 4 (24+). Output: cross-sectional summary table (currencies × cycles), per-asset bar chart (orange = hike, teal = cut), and cumulative return line chart with regime band shading.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM FX PERFORMANCE ACROSS FED HIKING & CUTTING CYCLES
# =============================================================================
# Inverted USD/EM pairs → positive return = EM currency appreciation
# 7 hardcoded Fed cycles from 2001 to present
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Invert: 1/USDXXX so that rising = EM strength
inv_close = 1.0 / close
daily_ret = (inv_close - (inv_close >> 1)) / (inv_close >> 1)
daily_ret_clean = daily_ret if is_valid(daily_ret) else 0.0

bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# FED CYCLE BOUNDARIES (hardcoded FOMC dates)
# Use datetime_diff to compare bar timestamps vs cycle boundaries
# days_from_X.value = bar_ts - X_date (positive = bar is after X)
# =============================================================================

# Cut 1: 2001-01-03 to 2003-06-25 (dot-com bust / 9-11, 6.5% → 1%)
cut1_s = timestamp_scalar(value='2001-01-03')()
cut1_e = timestamp_scalar(value='2003-06-25')()
days_from_cut1_s = datetime_diff(unit='days')(cut1_s.value, bar_ts)
days_from_cut1_e = datetime_diff(unit='days')(cut1_e.value, bar_ts)

# Hike 1: 2004-06-30 to 2006-06-29 (1% → 5.25%)
hike1_s = timestamp_scalar(value='2004-06-30')()
hike1_e = timestamp_scalar(value='2006-06-29')()
days_from_hike1_s = datetime_diff(unit='days')(hike1_s.value, bar_ts)
days_from_hike1_e = datetime_diff(unit='days')(hike1_e.value, bar_ts)

# Cut 2: 2007-09-18 to 2008-12-16 (GFC, 5.25% → 0.25%)
cut2_s = timestamp_scalar(value='2007-09-18')()
cut2_e = timestamp_scalar(value='2008-12-16')()
days_from_cut2_s = datetime_diff(unit='days')(cut2_s.value, bar_ts)
days_from_cut2_e = datetime_diff(unit='days')(cut2_e.value, bar_ts)

# Hike 2: 2015-12-16 to 2018-12-19 (normalization, 0.25% → 2.5%)
hike2_s = timestamp_scalar(value='2015-12-16')()
hike2_e = timestamp_scalar(value='2018-12-19')()
days_from_hike2_s = datetime_diff(unit='days')(hike2_s.value, bar_ts)
days_from_hike2_e = datetime_diff(unit='days')(hike2_e.value, bar_ts)

# Cut 3: 2019-07-31 to 2020-03-15 (insurance cuts + COVID, 2.5% → 0.25%)
cut3_s = timestamp_scalar(value='2019-07-31')()
cut3_e = timestamp_scalar(value='2020-03-15')()
days_from_cut3_s = datetime_diff(unit='days')(cut3_s.value, bar_ts)
days_from_cut3_e = datetime_diff(unit='days')(cut3_e.value, bar_ts)

# Hike 3: 2022-03-17 to 2023-07-26 (inflation fight, 0.25% → 5.5%)
hike3_s = timestamp_scalar(value='2022-03-17')()
hike3_e = timestamp_scalar(value='2023-07-26')()
days_from_hike3_s = datetime_diff(unit='days')(hike3_s.value, bar_ts)
days_from_hike3_e = datetime_diff(unit='days')(hike3_e.value, bar_ts)

# Cut 4: 2024-09-18 onwards (current easing, 5.5% → ongoing)
cut4_s = timestamp_scalar(value='2024-09-18')()
days_from_cut4_s = datetime_diff(unit='days')(cut4_s.value, bar_ts)

# =============================================================================
# REGIME FLAGS
# bar is in [start, end] when days_from_start >= 0 AND days_from_end <= 0
# =============================================================================

is_cut1 = (days_from_cut1_s.value >= 0) and (days_from_cut1_e.value <= 0)
is_hike1 = (days_from_hike1_s.value >= 0) and (days_from_hike1_e.value <= 0)
is_cut2 = (days_from_cut2_s.value >= 0) and (days_from_cut2_e.value <= 0)
is_hike2 = (days_from_hike2_s.value >= 0) and (days_from_hike2_e.value <= 0)
is_cut3 = (days_from_cut3_s.value >= 0) and (days_from_cut3_e.value <= 0)
is_hike3 = (days_from_hike3_s.value >= 0) and (days_from_hike3_e.value <= 0)
is_cut4 = days_from_cut4_s.value >= 0

# Composite regime flags for shading
is_any_cut = is_cut1 or is_cut2 or is_cut3 or is_cut4
is_any_hike = is_hike1 or is_hike2 or is_hike3

# =============================================================================
# PER-CYCLE GATED RETURNS (sum of daily returns ≈ total return)
# =============================================================================

ret_cut1 = where(is_cut1, daily_ret_clean)
ret_hike1 = where(is_hike1, daily_ret_clean)
ret_cut2 = where(is_cut2, daily_ret_clean)
ret_hike2 = where(is_hike2, daily_ret_clean)
ret_cut3 = where(is_cut3, daily_ret_clean)
ret_hike3 = where(is_hike3, daily_ret_clean)
ret_cut4 = where(is_cut4, daily_ret_clean)

# =============================================================================
# OVERALL CUMULATIVE RETURN FOR LINE CHART
# =============================================================================

cum_ret = cumulative()(daily_ret_clean)

# Band series: 1 when in regime, 0 otherwise (for shading)
cut_band = 1.0 if is_any_cut else 0.0
hike_band = 1.0 if is_any_hike else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# REPORT 1: CROSS-SECTIONAL SUMMARY TABLE
# Rows = BRL, MXN, ZAR | Columns = 7 cycles
# =============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title='EM FX Total Return by Fed Cycle',
    category='Fed Cycle Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    order=0,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Per-Cycle Returns',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Cut 1 (01-03)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hike 1 (04-06)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cut 2 (07-08)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hike 2 (15-18)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cut 3 (19-20)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hike 3 (22-23)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cut 4 (24+)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    )
)(ret_cut1, ret_hike1, ret_cut2, ret_hike2, ret_cut3, ret_hike3, ret_cut4)

# =============================================================================
# REPORT 2: PER-ASSET BAR CHART — one bar per cycle
# Orange = hiking cycles, Teal = cutting cycles
# =============================================================================

xy_bars(
    title='EM Currency Return by Fed Cycle',
    category='Fed Cycle Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_label='Total Return',
    order=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Cut 1 (01-03)', color=Color.Teal),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hike 1 (04-06)', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Cut 2 (07-08)', color=Color.Teal),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hike 2 (15-18)', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Cut 3 (19-20)', color=Color.Teal),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hike 3 (22-23)', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Cut 4 (24+)', color=Color.Teal)
    ])
)(ret_cut1, ret_hike1, ret_cut2, ret_hike2, ret_cut3, ret_hike3, ret_cut4)

# =============================================================================
# REPORT 3: CUMULATIVE RETURN LINE WITH REGIME BAND SHADING
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative EM Currency Return with Fed Regime Shading',
    category='Fed Cycle Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    order=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative Return', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cutting Cycle', color=Color.Teal, is_band=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Hiking Cycle', color=Color.Orange, is_band=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ])
)(bar_ts, cum_ret, cut_band, hike_band)
